entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments:
Show thyself; as the protector of thy people, able and ready to save them and punish those who rise up against them. 
 
Jehovah is a God of justice as well as mercy, and in the end will treat every man according to his work.

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: Thy heritage; Israel, as a "peculiar treasure" unto God "above all people."

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: The wicked act as if there were no God, or as if he did not regard them or their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Brutish--fools; the persons mentioned in the preceding verse, whose ignorance of God leads them to feel and act as though he did not see them or their works.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments:
Chastenest; the immediate reference is to the chastisement which God administers through the agency of the wicked spoken of in the preceding verses; but the words apply to chastisement in the widest sense. 
 
  Teachest--out of thy law; in connection with thy chastening hand. 
 
When God chastens his people, he teaches them by his Spirit out of his word.  The teaching of his Spirit with his chastening rod makes them wise unto eternal life, and thus most blessed for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: They who meekly submit themselves to God's chastisement, and learn the rich lessons of heavenly wisdom which it offers, shall find in God a sure resting place from trouble, and shall see the overthrow of the wicked who sought their destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments:
Judgment shall return unto righteousness; from which it seemed for a time to have departed.  Whatever present appearances may be, all the dealings of God will in the end appear to be righteous. 
 
  Shall follow it; shall welcome the return of God's righteous judgment, and follow its path with joy.

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments:
Almost dwelt in silence; would soon have died and been silent in the grave. 
 
The pious ascribe the continuance of all their blessings to the grace of God, and give him the glory.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments:
Thoughts; anxious and distracting thoughts. 
 
  Thy comforts; the consolations which thou givest.  These come in to cheer and tranquillize my spirit. 
 
Communion with God is a sure relief from anxious and distracting cares.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments:
The throne of iniquity; of wicked rulers who enact unjust and cruel laws. 
 
Laws of mischief and thrones of iniquity, though having transient power by God's permission, are offensive to him, and must receive his frown.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: The Lord will defend his people, and bring upon their enemies the evils which they thought to bring upon others; and though for a time the wicked may seem to prosper, they will finally perish, and have none to help them.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: Their own iniquity; its destructive effects.
